description.value:
Your shell represents an incredible collection of priceless objects, but your life is worth more than your precious baubles. If you have a shell and would die, you instead gain temporary Hit Points equal to twice your level that last for 1 minute. Your shell breaks, leaving hazardous terrain in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:10] centered on you that deals piercing damage equal to half your level (@Damage[(floor(@actor.level/2))[piercing]]) for each square a creature moves through. Whether you use the shards of your broken shell or new materials, rebuilding a new shell is a downtime activity that takes 8 hours.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feat-effects.Item.Effect: Sacrificial Shell]
